__1 Wanting, deficient, defective; किंचिदूनमनूनर्धेः शरदामयुतं ययौ [[R. 10. 1]]; incomplete, insufficient. 
__2 Less than (in number, size or degree); ऊनद्विवर्षं निखनत् [[Y. 3. 1]] less than two years old; ऊनं वाभ्यधिकं वापि [[Y. 2. 295.]] 
__3 Fewer, smaller. 
__4 Weaker, inferior; ऊनं न सत्त्वेष्वधिको बवाधे [[R. 2. 14]]; [Page0483-a2] [[Ms. 9. 123.]] 
__5 Minus (in this sense used with numerals); एकोन less by one; °बिंशतिः 20 minus 1 = 19; so °त्रिंशत् 29; °पञ्चाशत् 49; अष्टोनं शतम् 100 minus 8 = 92. 
-Comp. 
-अतिरिक्त a. Too little or too much.
